'''November 2000 Sioux Falls tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sioux Falls, South Dakota on 12 November 2000. [[Tyler Williams]] won it. It is known from Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1477">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-20-sioux-falls-sd-11-12-00d1477/ sioux-falls-sd-11-12-00], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 20 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-20-sioux-falls-sd-11-12-00d1477/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Sioux Falls, South Dakota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Tyler Williams]]
